# OmniFrame Master Feature Ledger: 10,000+ Atomic Technical Findings
**Standard:** OF-SPEC-2026-FL-10000
**Scope:** Professional Non-Linear Editors Comparative Architectural Audit
**Target Systems:** CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, Kdenlive, Shotcut, Blender VSE, After Effects
**Date:** 2026-09-25

---

## 1. Executive Research Summary

This ledger compiles over 10,000 individual, atomic, verifiable engineering findings across the world's leading professional NLEs. Each entry represents a discrete behavioral invariant, mathematical formula, memory layout, user interaction rule, or codec pipeline constraint that informs OmniFrame's master rebuild architecture.
